references.text: This verse gives the original count of the tribe of Simeon in the first census, which also shows 59,300 men, the same number mentioned here in the camp arrangement.
The second census of the tribe of Simeon shows 22,200 men, a significant decrease from the 59,300 mentioned in Numbers 2:13, illustrating the tribe's development during the wilderness journey.
Describes the birth of Simeon, the patriarch of the tribe counted in this verse.
Lists the sons of Simeon who went down to Egypt, the ancestors of the 59,300 men who were counted in the wilderness.
